docs.head.meta-content1: Developer guides and API reference for native agent integrations with OpenWalkieTalkie.
docs.content.p1: Put your agent’s conversations on the deck. Your app manages sessions and model connections; OpenWalkieTalkie handles the physical controls, voice input and compact display.
docs.content.p3: Grouped sessions, a new-chat launcher, live messages, multi-step questions, model / thinking effort settings, and the Omarchy face feed. The same interface used by Conol and the Omarchy bridge is available to any agent.
docs.content.p5: Install the unsigned Windows preview of the app and service, get past SmartScreen, and update your deck’s firmware over USB-C.
docs.content.p7: Build and install the service and the Omarchy bridge: the deck as a remote for Hyprland, your Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code sessions on the roster, and voice orders into their terminals.
docs.content.p8: Read the illustrated User Manual for setup, controls and troubleshooting, or print a copy to keep beside your desk.
docs.content.p9: Download the Python companion example. Run it with Python 3.10+ while OpenWalkieTalkie is open. It uses scripted replies and needs no packages, model API keys or Conol account.
docs.content.p10: Complete JSON-RPC API reference (Markdown), generated from the daemon’s request schemas and method permissions. The source repository includes the example and integration tests.
